provenance: Reconstructed on 2026-09-10. The run predates manifest support, so this file was written afterwards from evidence: settings from the 1530 metrics.csv rows, pipeline behaviour from the baseline commit, library versions from the .venv packages (all installed 2026-03-26 and not upgraded since, per their dist-info timestamps), hashes from the local files.

code.note: The run used the pre-refactor scripts run_experiments.py / run_experiment.py, later committed as baseline 730268b in the authors' private history (not part of this public repository). Their committed run_experiments.py has N_RUNS = 2, while the data holds 5 runs per configuration, so the invocation differed from that default at least in this constant. This repository's pipeline is a refactor of those scripts that keeps the detector, tracker and scoring settings; its quality metrics match these runs within run-to-run noise on the smoke subset; by default it also keeps their combined detect-and-track timing loop (see README).
code.paths_note: run_dir and mot_results_file in all_results.csv were rewritten on 2026-09-10 relative to the repository root, as the released pipeline writes them for a run of experiments/paper_main.yml (results/paper_main/<dataset>/<sequence>/<run>/). At run time they held absolute paths on the authors' machine, in the legacy layout results/<dataset>/<sequence>/<run>/. The per-run folders and track files are not shipped: all_results.csv holds every per-run row.

nms_iou_note: Not passed explicitly by the baseline; Ultralytics default (0.7). The refactored code pins the same value in detect.NMS_IOU.
shared_detection_note: The baseline ran detection and tracking in one combined per-frame loop, once per tracker. The released pipeline does the same unless shared_detection: true.
gt_filter: conf == 1 and class == 1 (pedestrian), applied at prepare time
prepared_gt_sha256_note: SHA-256 of prepared/<DATASET>/<SEQ>/gt/gt.txt with CRLF normalized to LF, so the value is the same on Windows and Linux (mot.py check applies the same normalization). The current data.prepare_sequence rebuilds these nine files byte-for-byte (after normalization) from the official MOT17-*-FRCNN, MOT20 and SOMPT22 train GT; verified 2026-09-10.
